answers.html: Write the new count to localStorage for the parent to read

answers.html: Query the parent's DOM and overwrite the rendered text

questions.name: ref-dot-value
questions.question_text: In a Vue <script setup> component, a developer declares const count = ref(0) but writes count = count + 1 in a click handler. What is the problem?

answers.text: ref() cannot be used inside script setup
answers.html: ref() cannot be used inside script setup

answers.text: count must be declared with let rather than const
answers.html: count must be declared with let rather than const

answers.text: The handler must be an arrow function for refs to work
answers.html: The handler must be an arrow function for refs to work

answers.text: A ref must be updated through .value, not reassigned
answers.html: A ref must be updated through .value, not reassigned

questions.name: named-export-import
questions.question_text: A file exports export function formatPrice(n) { ... }. Which import statement correctly brings it into another file?

answers.text: import { formatPrice } from './utils.js'
answers.html: import { formatPrice } from './utils.js'

answers.text: import formatPrice from './utils.js'
answers.html: import formatPrice from './utils.js'

answers.text: import * formatPrice from './utils.js'
answers.html: import * formatPrice from './utils.js'

answers.text: import './utils.js' as formatPrice
answers.html: import './utils.js' as formatPrice
